description:
Bupropion XL 150mg — 30 Tablets (Generic for Wellbutrin XL®) is a prescription medication used in the management of mood, anxiety, or psychiatric conditions under the guidance of a qualified healthcare provider. Each unit is dispensed in its sealed manufacturer packaging from our Cabo facility.

Typical dosing is individualized and titrated by the prescribing physician. Allow time for therapeutic response and do not discontinue abruptly. Consult your healthcare provider regarding side-effect profile, drug interactions, and any history of cardiovascular or hepatic conditions.

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1) before dispensing. Bilingual pharmacist consultation available 24/7.
